title: DataPraxis：通过经验证的工作区演化扩展分析任务
summary: DataPraxis 提出基于经验证工作区演化的分析任务合成框架，通过逐步丰富工作区并继承组合，生成更深入的分析任务，构建了 5000 条经验证轨迹数据集 DataPraxis-5K，训练出的 DataPraxis-27B 在 DABStep 和 JobBench 上匹配或超越前沿模型。
summary_en: DataPraxis introduces a verified workspace evolution framework for synthesizing analytics tasks, progressively enriching workspaces with validated findings and inheriting them to uncover deeper questions. It builds DataPraxis-5K, a 5,000-trajectory dataset, and trains DataPraxis-27B, which matches or surpasses frontier models like GLM-5.2 on DABStep and JobBench.
